exact_theorem: Let T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q). Construct a canonical, atlas-independent CE support-accounting datum (K_Z, T_Z, phi) for the ordered reduced-support evaluation-failure geometry: K_Z must be a named mixed-Hodge term in an explicitly constructed compactification, localization sequence, correspondence, or spectral sequence for M_{6,6}; phi must identify T_Z as a specified subquotient of T with the exact degree, weight, and Tate-twist conventions stated; and an exact filtration, quotient, or spectral-sequence accounting must prove both which part of T is T_Z and that no relevant Z-supported term is omitted. The construction must descend from any presentation/atlas to the same target datum. This theorem makes no Tate assertion and may not assume a closed embedding, Gysin map, support-exhaustion statement, or map to T without proving it.
route_policy: A blocked route may appear in methods_used only when new_inputs contains a matching route and evidence description.
